article.story: Chicago Bulls vs. Toronto Raptors Toronto; Wednesday, 7:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Raptors -9.5; over/under is 236.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Toronto Raptors start the season at home against the Chicago Bulls. Toronto finished 46-36 overall, 33-19 in Eastern Conference action and 24-17 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Raptors averaged 114.6 points per game while allowing opponents to score 111.8 last season. Chicago went 31-51 overall and 19-32 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Bulls averaged 28.5 assists per game on 42.4 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Raptors: None listed.
